主要内容: On June 30, 2016, Stephen Bragin informed Nicholas Financial, Inc. that he would retire as a member of the Board of Directors effective July 1, 2016. The Board appointed Todd Pfister as a director effective immediately to fill the vacancy left by Mr. Bragin's resignation. Ralph T. Finkenbrink, Chairman of the Board, President and Chief Executive Officer, expressed gratitude to Mr. Bragin for his service on the Board for more than 17 years. The company will hold its 2016 annual meeting of shareholders on September 8, 2016, with a record date of July 22, 2016.
